workflow.label: Clock in
workflow.hint: Make a worktree on <you>/TASK-id/slug from main and link node_modules.

workflow.label: Build
workflow.hint: Read the Notion task, ask about gaps, implement it.
workflow.prompt:
Work on Notion task {taskId}: {url}

Read the task, ask me about anything unclear, then implement it. Follow the repo's own conventions (CLAUDE.md, README, lint rules). Also:
- Skip the branching step. You are already in a git worktree at {worktree} on branch {branch}{extraDirs}. Do not switch branches or make another worktree.
- Stop before raising the PR. Workfloor has its own Checks and Raise PR steps.
- Commit your work on this branch with clear messages when a piece is done.
End with a short summary: what changed, what you verified, and anything that needs me.

workflow.label: Checks
workflow.hint: Types, lint and unit tests for the changed files, in the worktree.

workflow.label: Self review
workflow.hint: Code review of the branch diff before anyone else sees it.
workflow.prompt: Review the changes on this branch against {base}: run the code-review skill on `git diff origin/{base}...HEAD` (plus any uncommitted changes) at medium effort. List the findings, most severe first, each with file:line and a one-line fix. Do not apply fixes yet; I will reply with which ones to fix.

workflow.label: Sim test
workflow.hint: Drive the app on the iOS simulator and record evidence.
workflow.prompt: Test Notion task {taskId} ({url}) on the iOS simulator. Plan a few test cases from the task, run them on the simulator, and capture a screenshot for each. The code is in this worktree ({worktree}, branch {branch}). Report every case as PASS or FAIL with what you saw on screen.

workflow.label: Raise PR
workflow.hint: Push and open the PR, then link it on the Notion task.
workflow.prompt:
Raise the PR for Notion task {taskId} ({url}).
- Base branch: {base} (already confirmed by me; do not ask again). Skip the local review, Workfloor already ran it.
- Commit anything uncommitted that belongs to the task, push {branch}, then `gh pr create --base {base}`.
- Title: "{taskId}: <short summary>". Body starts with: Notion: [{taskId}]({url}) — "{title}". Then ## Summary, ## Edge cases, ## Known gaps, ## Test plan. Put these Workfloor check results in the test plan:
{checksSummary}
- Then update the Notion task: move its status to the one your team uses for review, and add the PR link to the page body.
Print the PR URL as the last line.

workflow.label: CI & comments
workflow.hint: Watch CI checks and review comments on the PR.
workflow.agentPrompt: Read the CI results and review comments on PR {prUrl} (`gh pr checks`, `gh pr view --comments`, and inline review comments via `gh api repos/{owner}/{repoName}/pulls/{prNumber}/comments`). Fix failing checks and address each review comment on this branch, commit, and push. Summarize what you changed per comment.
